uyk27: Sleep and pain feed into each other: pain breaks up your sleep, and poor sleep makes you more sensitive to pain. In healthy volunteers, even a single night without sleep has been shown to increase sensitivity to pain. That is why, if you live with low back, neck or joint pain, improving your sleep is part of your treatment.

uyk43: Why does sleep matter so much?
uyk44: A widely watched TED talk in which sleep scientist Matt Walker explains the role sleep plays in learning, immunity and heart health.
uyk45: Play the TED talk on sleep
uyk47: Some of the more striking claims in the talk are debated among scientists; its core message, that regular and sufficient sleep matters, is widely accepted.
uyk48: How many hours should adults sleep?
uyk49: According to a joint recommendation from the American Academy of Sleep Medicine and the Sleep Research Society, adults aged 18–60 should regularly sleep 7 hours or more a night. Whether sleeping more than 9 hours a night is linked to health risks is uncertain.
uyk50: Does coffee in the afternoon affect my sleep?
uyk51: It can. In one study, 400 mg of caffeine (about 2–3 cups of coffee) taken 6 hours before bed cut measured sleep time by more than an hour. If you have trouble sleeping, try stopping coffee and tea by early afternoon.
uyk52: What is the first-choice treatment for chronic insomnia?
uyk53: The American College of Physicians (ACP) recommends cognitive behavioural therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) as the first treatment for chronic insomnia. It works on your sleep pattern, the link between your bed and sleep, and your worries about sleep. Decide together with your doctor whether or not to use sleeping pills.
uyk55: Snoring on its own is not always a sign of illness. If loud snoring comes with pauses in breathing during sleep, waking up as if choking or excessive sleepiness during the day, see a doctor to be checked for sleep apnoea.
uyk56: When should you see a doctor?
uyk57: Sleeping badly now and then is normal. But see a doctor if:
uyk58: You have struggled to fall asleep or stay asleep on most nights for weeks, and you feel the effects during the day
uyk59: Loud snoring comes with pauses in breathing during sleep or waking up as if choking
uyk60: You are excessively sleepy during the day, especially if you nod off while driving
uyk61: An unpleasant feeling in your legs in the evening, with an urge to move them, stops you from falling asleep
uyk62: Your sleeplessness comes with marked low mood or anxiety
